title: The Half-Light Radiators
author: M. M. Zhou
blurb: Oscar Ravensworth, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
